supervisor.value: You need the endorsement of a prospective supervisor, and you can start at any time of year by prior arrangement with your nominated supervisor.
supervisor.quote: The endorsement of a prospective supervisor. | Students may commence a DR-PHILEIT (Doctor of Philosophy - Engineering and IT) at any time during the year subject to prior arrangement with their nominated supervisor.

funding.value: You are automatically considered for a Graduate Research Scholarship (stipend AUD 41,100 a year in 2027 and/or tuition fee remission); these go to the highest-ranked applicants, and without a fee scholarship you may be offered a full fee-paying place.
funding.quote: If eligible, you'll automatically be considered for a Graduate Research Scholarship that provides a living allowance and/or tuition fee remission scholarship. More than 300 of these scholarships are offered to international graduate researchers each year. | If you're unsuccessful in gaining a tuition fee remission scholarship, you may be offered a place as a full fee-paying student.

also.quote: A fortnightly stipend with a rate of $41,100 per year pro rata (2027 full-time rate) for up to two years for students undertaking a Masters by Research degree or up to 3.5 years for students undertaking a doctoral degree. | The Melbourne Research Scholarship is offered to students who are ranked highest by relevant selection panels

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's (such as a BTech/BE) with a research component of at least 25% of a full-time year and a final-year average of at least 75%, or a master's with such a research component and a 75% average; a research proposal is also required.
entry_route.quote: A four-year bachelor degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component equivalent to at least 25% of one year of full-time study, and have achieved a minimum weighted average of 75% in the final year subjects or (University of Melbourne) equivalent | A masters degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component equivalent to at least 25% of one year of full-time study, and achieved a minimum weighted average of 75% or (University of Melbourne) equivalent
